content.title: TMC Stock Surges On Undersea Mining Permit Hopes
content.summary: The Metals Company shares tacked on further gains on Friday, a day after the undersea mining company said it filed a new permit application under an expedited process finalized on Wednesday by the Trump administration.  TMC is seeking to recover more than 800 million metric tons of wet nodules containing nickel, copper, cobalt and manganese.  The New York Times reported on Friday that TMC CEO Gerard Barron said he was "highly confident" that a permit would be granted this year in an appearance at a Thursday hearing of the House Subcommittee on Energy and Mineral Resources.
